trl_rationale: Concept study only: science targets, mission architecture, analyses and simulated locomotion. No hardware built or tested. 'A proof-of-concept BALLET on Earth is possible' is a statement of possibility, not a test.

evidence.quote: An entry, descent and landing architecture was developed for BALLET on Mars and Titan.
Coordinated control of the cable system and feet placement for locomotion, a problem unique to BALLET, has been shown to be algorithmically feasible.

criteria_origin: derived from evidence[].trl_level (the TRL's own level met, higher levels insufficient evidence) and DEMO-C02 met (APCTT-C10 met); lower levels, APCTT-C11 and APCTT-C12 not labelled yet
review_notes: Trap on p.45: 'currently low-TRL technology' refers to thin-film photovoltaics, not BALLET itself. NTRS licence GOV_PERMITTED; pages carry a Caltech copyright line.
